text:
Marta (plat-pm): Quick heads-up — I noticed some tenants in the cost dashboard showing NEGATIVE cache savings for a canary we rolled yesterday. :eyes:
James (eng): Negative? hmm. Do you have an example tenant id or route?
Marta (plat-pm): route=/chat/compose tenant=acme-inc. On the per-model breakout the cache column is -12% for the last hour. Dashboard link: https://console/redwood/costs?slice=acme-inc (screenshot posted)
Adele (data): I've seen artifacts when session affinity pins requests to different model variants mid-chain. Might be double-counting KV cache misses as extra cost.
Samir (sre): Could be sampling/aggregation edge-case too. Our telemetry rolls up "prefetch" credits and "direct hits" separately, then subtracts — if joins are wrong you can get negative.
James (eng): Reproduced locally with a small synthetic workload: chain = [retriever -> rewriter -> generator], affinity pinned rewriter to v2 and generator to v1. The cache fingerprinting key changed between v2/v1 so the prefetch credit was applied to the wrong model.
Marta (plat-pm): So the UX shows net savings but math is off. Customers will be freaked seeing negative savings. We should either clamp to 0 or show an explanation.
Nora (product): Preference is to avoid masking real negatives from perf regressions. But we should hide obviously invalid negatives and surface reason: "inconsistent model fingerprinting across chain".
James (eng): Proposed quick fix: in the aggregator, clamp cache_savings_pct = max(cache_savings_pct, -5%) for the next 24h while we root-cause. Longer term fix is to propagate canonical cache_fingerprint across chains.
Adele (data): Patch idea for aggregator SQL:```sql
SELECT tenant, model, GREATEST(SUM(prefetch_credit - actual_token_cost), -0.05 * SUM(actual_token_cost)) as capped_savings
FROM token_rollups
GROUP BY tenant, model;
```
Samir (sre): That will stop the scary negative bars. But also add an alert rule when capped events exceed 1% of tenants. I'll add to infra-bot.
infra-bot: alert created: cost.dashboard.negative-cache-capped — severity=low — owners=eng-platform,sre
James (eng): For the canonical fingerprint we need a small API change in the runtime: when chaining, carry the first model's cache_fingerprint in the request metadata. Pseudocode:```json
{"chain_meta": {"origin_cache_fp": "abc123"}}
```
Marta (plat-pm): Timeline?
James (eng): I can do a hotfix to aggregator today (1-2h). Runtime change will be a small PR but needs QA — likely 2 days.
Nora (product): Can we add a tooltip on the dashboard explaining the clamp and linking to an incident/notes? Customers need transparency.
Adele (data): Also we should re-run yesterday's canary with corrected join logic to backfill corrected savings. I'll run a consistency check job: compare raw tokens vs post-agg for anomalies.
Samir (sre): I'll schedule a canary replay in the staging cluster and capture traces for a sample tenant.
James (eng): One more caveat — quotas and cost attribution: if we clamp savings, billing-facing reports should not be affected. We'll keep billing pipeline untouched; clamp only affects the UX/observability panel.
Marta (plat-pm): Good call. Action items: 1) James: aggregator clamp hotfix (in eng-platform) 2) James: runtime chain_meta PR (follow-up) 3) Adele: run backfill/consistency job 4) Samir: staging replay + traces 5) Nora: dashboard tooltip copy.
Nora (product): I'll draft tooltip: "We detected inconsistent cache attribution for multi-model chains; values temporarily clamped. See internal notes: https://go/internal/cost-issues/3723456789"
James (eng): Hotfix PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/platform/pull/4823 — includes tests + migration.
Adele (data): Consistency job started (job-id=cost-check-3723). Will post results in 30m.
Samir (sre): Staging replay scheduled for 14:00 UTC. Will attach perf traces.
Marta (plat-pm): Thanks all. Once hotfix is live let's check the dashboard and if negatives gone, announce a short note in #general so sales/customer success don't get pinged. :thumbsup:
James (eng): Hotfix deployed to staging, will promote to prod after 10m smoke tests.
Adele (data): Job finished — anomalies found for 3 tenants, all match the model-variant fingerprint flip. I'll paste csv to the incident doc.
Marta (plat-pm): Closing loop later today. If anyone wants to pair on the runtime change ping me.
Nora (product): I'll prepare the customer-facing wording after we confirm numbers.
James (eng): Last: let's add a unit test for chain fingerprint carry and a small integration test that simulates model-variant mismatch. I'll add to the PR.
infra-bot: deployment success: platform-aggregator v2.14.1 -> prod (by James)
Marta (plat-pm): Verified — dashboard negatives replaced with small 0..3% values and tooltip live. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
